summary: This note is a short encyclopedic biography of Bahram Mirza Moezz-od-Dowleh Qajar (1806–1882). He was the second son of Abbas Mirza, who was the youngest son of Fat'h Ali Shah Qajar. The note describes him as an educated, erudite man known for expertise in many subjects, earning the nickname "Mollah Bahram", and states that as uncle of Naser al-Din Shah he served as minister of justice during that reign.
one_line: Bahram Mirza Moezz-od-Dowleh Qajar (1806–1882) was an erudite Qajar prince who served as minister of justice under his nephew Naser al-Din Shah.
key_facts: Bahram Mirza Moezz-od-Dowleh Qajar lived from 1806 to 1882.
Bahram Mirza was the second son of Abbas Mirza.
Abbas Mirza was the youngest son of Fat'h Ali Shah Qajar.
Bahram Mirza was an educated and erudite man expert on many subjects.
Bahram Mirza was nicknamed "Mollah Bahram", meaning Knowledgeable Bahram.
Bahram Mirza was the uncle of Naser al-Din Shah.
Bahram Mirza served as minister of justice during the reign of Naser al-Din Shah.
